thread:
Nadia: short bring-up for marigold14b. ran int8, int6, and int4-GPTQ on a mixed product slice (short chat, long summary, rerank). pulling out cost-vs-quality tradeoffs + traffic recommendations.

Nadia: perf snapshot (batch=1, seq=1280):
```
int8  tp 10.4 req/s, p50 48ms, p95 180ms, p99 420ms, cost ~$0.036 / 1k tokens
int6  tp 9.1  req/s, p50 54ms, p95 210ms, p99 480ms, cost ~$0.027 / 1k tokens
int4  tp 16.0 req/s, p50 30ms, p95 100ms, p99 260ms, cost ~$0.015 / 1k tokens
```

Nadia: quality (GTN 9k samples):
- fp16 baseline exact-match-like metric 0.783
- int8 0.778 (-0.5 pts)
- int6 0.769 (-1.4 pts)
- int4 0.744 (-3.9 pts)

Omar: unit econ back-of-envelope assuming 1.8k tokens/request -> int8 ~$0.065/req, int6 ~$0.049/req, int4 ~$0.027/req. Moving 50% traffic to int6 saves ~ $8.8k per 100k requests vs fp16.

Yuki: product note: regressions are concentrated on chain-of-thought and multi-document summarization. single-turn completions unaffected.

Sam: ops saw edge-case decode errors on int4 with long contexts; filed #ML-987. recommend disabling int4 for any route touching multi-doc merge until a fix.

Nadia: suggested traffic rules:
- summaries & multi-doc rerank: pin int8
- short chat (<=200 tokens, <=2 turns): allow int4 behind postfilter + shadowing
- general chat: int6 primary, int8 fallback
Example routing snippet: {"model":"marigold14b","routes":{"summaries":{"int8":1.0},"chat-short":{"int4":0.7,"int6":0.3},"chat-long":{"int6":0.8,"int8":0.2}},"fallback":"int8","canary_samples":5000} (pushed to canary template)

Omar: GTN gating (48h smoke): metric drop <=1.2 pts absolute on summary slice, p99 latency <=500ms, client error rate <=0.2%. If canary fails for summaries -> rollback.

Yuki: mitigation experiments: quick quant-finetune (4k steps) predicted to recover ~1.0-1.6 pts for int6 and ~2.5 pts for int4 on single-doc slices; mixed-int decode (prefix int4, decode int8) recovered ~1.0 pt for int4 in our bench.

Sam: checklist before any canary: apply int4 decode safety patch, KV-cache alignment PR, add postfiltering for cheap-completions, shadow run 4h. Tentative canary window tonight 23:30 UTC.

Nadia: decision recs for GTN docs: start with conservative canary: enable int6 for chat-long & general chat at 30% initially; enable int4 only for chat-short in internal beta behind postfilter. Run quant-finetune in parallel and re-evaluate after 7 days.

canary-bot: Canary scheduled: marigold14b-int6 -> 2024-09-18T23:30Z, samples=5000, owner=Sam. Monitoring: latency, exact-match, errors, postfilter-failures.

Nadia: tagging @Omar @Yuki @Sam — please post results and the 50k slice eval when ready. Closing for now. High-level: int6 is the pragmatic cost-quality sweet spot; int4 useful only for aggressive cost tiers with strong filtering and further calibration. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
